scope: Every floating point multiply that the pinned Go reference's arm64 build fuses into an add or subtract (FMADDD, FMSUBD, FNMSUBD, FNMADDD), in the simulation packages and the exporter, and what the Rust runtime does at each site.
method: List the fused instructions of the oracle binary with go tool objdump, by function and Go source line.
Read the operands of each runtime site from the disassembly where its line holds several operations.
Port each runtime site with mul_add in the fused shape; mark sites the export resolves, sites the runtime does not reach, and sites where both forms agree for every input.
Require every Go golden and every recorded sweep and race board to keep matching.
Search randomized variants for ones where the runtime before and after the audit log differently, and let Go decide each.

evidence.fixtures: All 193 prepared v2 fixtures keep their Go goldens and Rust matches each.

sweeps.note: Every sweep and race board under validation/, rerun after the audit: no mismatch. The rejections are those the records list; the Enhancement Shaman records are older than later work that made their four rejected variants run, and they match.

after_merging_0705079.scan: The rescan finds only exporter sites new; the bear shift's health fraction is fused in classes::druid::spells::bear_form, and Expose Armor's armor values come from the export.

evidence.search_note: python3 tools/sweep.py draws the variants of each production request; each is exported once and run by the runtime at 076116f and after the audit. The second and third searches compare results within the comparison tolerance and find no difference; four first-fight logs differ across the searches, and Go matches the audited runtime on each while the older one logs 0.001 or a 0.1 debug base off.
